signature: SUBROUTINE DLAEXC( WANTQ, N, T, LDT, Q, LDQ, J1, N1, N2, WORK,

params.name: wantq
params.reference: = .TRUE. : accumulate the transformation in the matrix Q; = .FALSE.: do not accumulate the transformation.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix T. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: T
params.reference: On entry, the upper quasi-triangular matrix T, in Schur canonical form. On exit, the updated matrix T, again in Schur canonical form.

params.name: ldt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array T. $\mathrm{LDT} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: Q
params.reference: On entry, if `WANTQ` is .TRUE., the orthogonal matrix Q. On exit, if `WANTQ` is .TRUE., the updated matrix Q. If `WANTQ` is .FALSE., Q is not referenced.

params.name: ldq
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Q. $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge 1$; and if `WANTQ` is .TRUE., $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge N$.

params.name: j1
params.reference: The index of the first row of the first block T11.

params.name: n1
params.reference: The order of the first block T11. `N1 = 0`, 1 or 2.

params.name: n2
params.reference: The order of the second block T22. `N2 = 0`, 1 or 2.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `= 1`: the transformed matrix T would be too far from Schur form; the blocks are not swapped and T and Q are unchanged.
